target.sable: packaged runtime dependency; exact physics version to verify from launch

scope: No functional equivalence may be inferred from rendering, source inspection or build success.

levels.native_passed: A real running NeoForge+official Mods runtime GameTest and reproducible evidence demonstrate the function.
levels.preview_only: A JavaScript approximation or native-like UI demonstration exists; NOT mechanically authoritative.
levels.native_unverified: Not demonstrated in game; acceptance blocked.

prior_evidence.static_model_e2e: 23 representative official JAR block models inspected; 17 original static meshes resolved, 6 partial, 0 missing; NOT gameplay functionality.
prior_evidence.source_code: viewer/rpms/strict-core.mjs documents a narrow preview-only kinetic network. The Java NeoForge StudioMod is a loading baseline and currently does not integrate Create/Aeronautics gameplay.

acceptance_policy: Full native operation cannot be claimed until EVERY applicable domain has native_passed with precise reproducible run evidence and game version/config; native_unverified remains failing.
